faqs.question: Is a deposit mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, almost all EORs require a 1-2 month refundable deposit to cover notice periods and severance liability.

faqs.question: Can EOR employees get stock options?
faqs.answer: Yes, via NSO (Non-Qualified Stock Options) or Phantom Stock plans. ISOs are generally not possible without a direct entity.

faqs.question: What is the notice period?
faqs.answer: Standard is 60-90 days for tech roles. It can be negotiated to 30 days, but 90 days is market norm for senior roles.

sections.subtitle: New Regime (2025-26)
sections.description: Default tax rates for Indian employees unless they opt for the old regime with deductions.

items.title: Nil Tax
items.text: No tax on income up to ₹3,00,000 per annum.

items.title: Rebate (Sec 87A)
items.text: Net tax is zero if total taxable income is up to ₹7,00,000 (standard for junior roles).

items.title: Max Rate
items.text: 30% tax on all income exceeding ₹15,00,000 + 4% Health & Education Cess.

faqs.question: What is CTC vs In-Hand?
faqs.answer: CTC (Cost to Company) is the total spend. In-Hand is CTC minus PF (User share), Prof Tax, and Income Tax (TDS). In-hand is typically 70-85% of CTC.

faqs.question: Is PF mandatory?
faqs.answer: Mandatory for Basic Salary < ₹15,000/month. However, most companies cap PF contribution at 12% of ₹15,000 (i.e., ₹1800) or on full Basic for higher salaries.

faqs.question: What is Gratuity?
faqs.answer: A lump sum benefit paid after 5 years of continuous service. Calculated as 15 days of last drawn Basic salary for every completion year.

items.title: Provident Fund (PF)
items.text: 12% of Basic (+ DA) each by Employee & Employer.

items.title: ESIC
items.text: Health insurance for salaries < ₹21k/month (3.25% Employer, 0.75% Employee).

items.title: Prof Tax (PT)
items.text: State-level tax (max ₹2,500/year) deducted from salary.

faqs.question: What is the New Tax Regime?
faqs.answer: A default tax scheme with lower rates but zero deductions (no HRA or 80C exemptions). Best for high-CTC roles without investments.

faqs.question: How is LOP calculated?
faqs.answer: Gross Salary / Days in Month * Days Absent. Payroll systems automate this based on biometric data.

faqs.question: What is the replacement guarantee?
faqs.answer: Most agencies offer a 90-day free replacement period if the candidate leaves.

faqs.question: Is 'Notice Period Buyout' common?
faqs.answer: Yes, in a competitive tech market, employers may pay the shortfall in notice period to onboard candidates faster.

faqs.question: Are regional language skills necessary?
faqs.answer: For customer support or sales in specific states (TN, WB, MH), regional fluency is often a core requirement.

faqs.question: Can expats buy property?
faqs.answer: Generally No. Foreign nationals (non-OCI) cannot buy agricultural land/farmhouses. Residential property requires specific RBI approval or 183-day residency.

faqs.question: Is health insurance necessary?
faqs.answer: Highly recommended. Private healthcare in metros (Apollo, Manipal) is world-class but expensive without coverage.
